description: This file defines the QConnectClient class, a client for interacting with the Amazon Q Connect service in the AWS SDK for PHP. It uses PHP namespaces and contains method annotations for various API actions related to Amazon Q Connect, including creating, deleting, and managing resources like agents, prompts, content, and more.

classes.name: QConnectClient
classes.description: A client class that provides methods to interact with the Amazon Q Connect service through AWS SDK for PHP.

methods.name: activateMessageTemplate
methods.description: Method to activate a message template in Amazon Q Connect.

methods.name: createAIAgent
methods.description: Method to create an AI agent in Amazon Q Connect.
